title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, not translated into Estonian]
catch.success: Your catch: {rarity} {fish}! [with the inserted names this reads e.g. "Müütiline Kuldne karpkala", with a capital letter on both words mid-phrase]
pass.auto_reel: Auto-reeling [the "auto-" prefix in Estonian compounds usually means "car", so it can also read as "car reeling"]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles the chance to catch rare fish!
ascend.button: Elevation [a noun ("elevation/exaltation/promotion"), not a verb; uncommon, bookish word for a button]
ascend.confirm: Do you want elevation right now? You start over from the beginning, but you catch rare fish {bonus}% more often. [the opening question is stiff and unnatural]
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting.
quest.title: Tasks
quest.claim: Receive [can also read as "Accept", as in accepting a new task, rather than collecting a reward]
friends.boost: Fishing together with friends gives you +{percent}% luck
trade.sent: You offered a trade to player {player}
codes.redeemed: Code redeemed! The reward is yours.
afk.kicked: You were inactive for too long and fishing stopped.
event.ends: Ends in {time} [grammatical only if {time} is in the genitive case, e.g. "5 minuti"; a plain number-plus-unit value may read wrong]
daily.streak: Day {day} in a row! Come back tomorrow and get more rewards!
tip.night: Tip: some fish bite only at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 bait for free!
